pm.title: Private messages
pm.description: Manage conversations relayed through the Telegram forum. Only panel admins can reply.
pm.search: Search name, username or Telegram ID
pm.emptyHint: Qualified users appear here after sending a direct message to the bot.
pm.repairHint: Inspect Telegram first, then attach the existing topic. A new profile card is created when its message ID is blank.
pm.topicIdHint: Use the topic ID from its Telegram link. The General topic cannot be used.
pm.profileIdHint: Use an existing bot profile card to avoid creating another one.
pm.pending: The profile card update is queued.
pm.reviewHint: Delivery is uncertain after an interrupted request. Check Telegram before resending; uncertain messages are never replayed automatically.
pm.loadFailed: Private messages could not be loaded.
pm.actionFailed: The profile or topic update failed. Local moderation preferences remain saved.
pm.deliveryFailed: Delivery failed. Check the Telegram destination and bot permissions.
pm.userProfileHint: Manage this member's PM routing and review delivery and read status.
pm.noConversationForUser: This member has not started a PM conversation.

errors.PM_CONTENT_EXPIRED: Pending message content expired. Send the message again from the forum.
errors.PM_CONTENT_INVALID: Pending message content could not be restored. Send the message again from the forum.
errors.PM_TOPIC_UNCERTAIN: Topic creation needs review. Attach its existing ID after checking Telegram.
errors.PM_PROFILE_UNCERTAIN: The profile card delivery needs review. Attach its message ID or confirm a new card.
errors.PM_DELIVERY_UNCERTAIN: Delivery may have succeeded. Check Telegram before sending this message again.
errors.PM_DISABLED: Messaging was disabled or the destination changed before delivery.
errors.PM_BLOCKED: Delivery was stopped by moderation or administrator permissions.
errors.PM_ENTRY_REQUIRED: The member must open and verify the panel before messages can be relayed.
errors.PM_TELEGRAM_REJECTED: Telegram rejected this delivery. Check the source message, topic and bot permissions.
